say:74:1826036042:1.source_cn: 既然你是从禁卫军口中得知的，那么就该向他们确认。何必来问余？

say:76:1826036045:1.text: Anyway, His Majesty expects this matter to be resolved without delay. I trust you'll have the culprit apprehended in due course.
say:76:1826036045:1.source_cn: 那么还请尽快抓捕犯人，给托安陛下一个交代。

say:77:1826036046:1.text: By the way, I understand vampires have a custom of keeping the living as blood thralls. I've handpicked a few of my finest pets as a gift for you.

say:78:1826036047:1.text: Pets... The way Salazer refers to the living makes your hair stand on end. You shudder to imagine how he treats them.

say:81:1826036049:1.text: I appreciate your kind gesture, but I have no need for blood thralls. I sent them all away long ago.
say:81:1826036049:1.source_cn: 多谢你的好意，但不必了。余不需要血仆侍奉，早已将他们全...

say:82:1826036050:1.text: King Thoran loathes the presence of the living in Bantus. I'd advise you to keep your pets out of his sight.
say:82:1826036050:1.source_cn: 何况托安陛下最厌恶班题斯境内有生者来往。小心你的宠物会...

say:83:1826036051:1.text: Heh... Thanks for your concern. I'll keep that in mind.
say:83:1826036051:1.source_cn: 呵……多谢您的提醒，我一定牢记。

say:84:1826036052:1.text: Now, it's about time I take my leave. I have a <style="highlight">banquet to attend</style>. A friend in Novaris was kind enough to invite me.

say:85:1826036053:1.text: I look forward to seeing you at the palace next time, Lady Tephesia. I'm sure it will be... most delightful.
say:85:1826036053:1.source_cn: 期待下一次能在王宫中见到您的身影。那一定会是……非常美...

say:87:1826036043:1.text: Who knows? It's possible that the Lightbearer mage made someone else at the Repair House take the fall.
say:87:1826036043:1.source_cn: 又或许，是那个魔法师栽赃到修缮屋其他人身上的。谁能说得准呢？

cinematic_dialogue:2:1826040001:.text: I can't afford to wait any longer.

cinematic_dialogue:2:1826040002:.text: When exactly will the Repair House be back in business?
cinematic_dialogue:2:1826040002:.source_cn: 修缮屋什么时候才能重新开张？

cinematic_dialogue:2:1826040003:.text: There's no point tearing your hair out over this.

say:6:1826041001:1.source_cn: 两位贵族朋友，你们在为什么事而烦恼？

say:7:1826041002:1.text: Excuse me, but I just overheard you mention the Repair House... Is it closed because of a shortage of fresh limbs?
say:7:1826041002:1.source_cn: 我似乎隐约听你们提到了修缮屋……莫非是因为缺少新鲜的断肢？

say:8:1826041003:1.text: No, Novaris has plenty of limbs these days. What we lack is skilled physicians.
say:8:1826041003:1.source_cn: 不，诺珐斯早已不缺肢体供给。现在的问题是没有医师。

say:9:1826041004:1.text: Baba Muriel used to run the Repair House, but she vanished without a trace once Bantus started hunting her. No one knows where she is now.
say:9:1826041004:1.source_cn: 修缮屋以前的医师是穆婆婆，但她被通缉以后，就莫名其妙地...

say:10:1826041005:1.text: For some reason, Her Ladyship has yet to appoint a replacement for Baba Muriel... My knees and wrists can wait, but my eyes can't hold out much longer!
say:10:1826041005:1.source_cn: 不知道为何，领主阁下也没有派遣新的医师接手修缮屋……我...

say:11:1826041006:1.text: Oh? Are there no other physicians in Novaris?
say:11:1826041006:1.source_cn: 哦？诺珐斯城内难道没有其他医师了吗？

say:12:1826041007:1.text: There are, but Baba Muriel was in a league of her own. She was the only physician to receive Her Ladyship's approval, after all.
say:12:1826041007:1.source_cn: 自然是有的，只是他们的技术都不如穆婆婆精湛。毕竟她是唯...

say:13:1826041008:1.text: I'd never entrust my body to those shady back-alley clinics.
say:13:1826041008:1.source_cn: 身为贵族，我是绝不会去那些黑心小作坊接受手术的。

say:15:1826041010:1.text: Rest easy, my friends. <style="highlight">I'll write to King Thoran about your plight</style>, and I'm sure a first-rate physician will be sent your way before long.

say:16:1826041011:1.text: You would do that for us? How warm-hearted of you!
say:16:1826041011:1.source_cn: 哦，真的吗？您可真是一位热心的绅士！

say:17:1826041012:1.text: Heh... People with "warm hearts" have always appealed to me.
say:17:1826041012:1.source_cn: 呵呵……我的确很喜欢“热心”。

say:18:1826041013:1.text: Judging by your attire, you must be a Bantus nobleman. If you can spare the time, I'd love for you to attend my housewarming banquet at the next new moon.
say:18:1826041013:1.source_cn: 这位先生，看您的打扮，应该是来自班题斯的贵族吧？如果您...

say:19:1826041014:1.text: After all, opportunities to befriend a gentleman like you don't come along every day.
say:19:1826041014:1.source_cn: 毕竟，能结交您这样的绅士的机会可不多。

say:20:1826041015:1.text: I'm deeply honored by your invitation.
say:20:1826041015:1.source_cn: 能收到你的邀请，真是我的无上荣幸啊。

say:21:1826041016:1.text: But I have other engagements later. Once I've wrapped things up, I'll certainly stop by your manor.
say:21:1826041016:1.source_cn: 我稍后还有安排，等我的事情结束后，一定前往你的府邸拜访。

say:27:1826041018:1.source_cn: ——真是太棒了！这是我府邸的地址，请您务必收好。

say:28:1826041019:1.text: I look forward to your visit later.
say:28:1826041019:1.source_cn: 那么，我们就在家中恭候您的到来了。

say:32:1826041021:1.text: Tres, I have a few questions. Would you care to enlighten me?
say:32:1826041021:1.source_cn: 我有一些疑问，不知道你能否为我解答。

say:33:1826041022:1.text: That Baba Muriel... Where is she now? I know she isn't in the Imperial Guard's custody.
say:33:1826041022:1.source_cn: 修缮屋原来的医生——那个被通缉的穆婆婆，她去哪了？禁卫...

say:34:1826041023:1.text: My apologies, Viscount Salazer. I only attend to matters within the manor, so I'm unfamiliar with the city's affairs.
say:34:1826041023:1.source_cn: 我只负责莫蒂默庄园内的事务，不清楚城内政务。请您谅解。

say:35:1826041024:1.text: Alright, let me rephrase that. Why hasn't Lady Tephesia found a replacement for Baba Muriel? Or is appointing a physician too much for Lady Tephesia these days?
say:35:1826041024:1.source_cn: 那么我换个问题。为什么穆婆婆失踪了多日，新医师还没有上...

say:37:1826041026:1.text: Rest assured, Her Ladyship is perfectly well. She has a considerable backlog of matters to attend to.
say:37:1826041026:1.source_cn: 您多虑了，领主阁下一切安好。只是因为最近政务繁忙，很多...

say:38:1826041027:1.text: Are you suggesting that she's too lazy to complete her duties?
say:38:1826041027:1.source_cn: 你是想告诉我，是因为她太懒了吗？

say:39:1826041028:1.text: Her Ladyship has always been this way. Everyone is well aware.
say:39:1826041028:1.source_cn: 领主阁下的心性，有目共睹。

say:40:1826041029:1.text: Indeed... which leaves me nothing to argue with.
say:40:1826041029:1.source_cn: 是啊……所以才能令我无从反驳。

say:41:1826041030:1.text: Let's <style="highlight">carry on with the tour</style>. I believe there's plenty more for me to see in Novaris.

narration:43:18060131:0.text: Two nobles in Novaris are fretting over the Repair House's closure. Feigning concern, Salazer approaches them to fish for information.
narration:43:18060131:0.source_cn: 诺珐斯城内，两位贵族正因修缮屋的关闭而烦心不已。斯莱泽...

cinematic_dialogue:2:1826046003:.text: Or I might hit somewhere that hurts even more.
cinematic_dialogue:2:1826046003:.source_cn: 否则打偏了，可不能怪我

say:5:1826047001:1.text: I hadn't expected you to buckle so quickly... You really are spineless.
say:5:1826047001:1.source_cn: 没想到你竟然这么快就求饶了，真是……没有骨气啊。

say:6:1826047002:1.text: Now, shall we play a little game?
say:6:1826047002:1.source_cn: 不如这样，我们来做一个游戏如何？

say:7:1826047003:1.text: Answer my questions correctly, and you'll be rewarded. If you get them wrong... you'll suffer.
say:7:1826047003:1.source_cn: 如果你能答对，我就给你奖励。但要是你答错了……我也只能...

say:8:1826047004:1.text: I-I don't want anything! Please... just let me go!
say:8:1826047004:1.source_cn: 我……我不要奖励！只求求……求求您放过我！

say:9:1826047005:1.text: That's not for you to decide.

say:10:1826047006:1.text: Tell me... How long has it been since Lady Tephesia, that insufferable little vampire, last showed her face?
say:10:1826047006:1.source_cn: 我问你，你们的领主……那个恶劣的小吸血鬼，有多久没出现了？

say:11:1826047007:0.text: I-I may hold a noble title, but I've never had the privilege of meeting Her Lady—
say:11:1826047007:0.source_cn: 我……我只是个小贵族，根本接触不到领主阁——

say:14:1826047009:0.text: My, what a piercing scream. Look around you. So many of your friends are waiting their turn. Think carefully, and don't waste my time with useless answers.
say:14:1826047009:0.source_cn: 虽然我很享受你的尖叫，但看看周围——还有这么多人在等待...

say:16:1826047011:1.text: I think... Her Ladyship's never been seen since the lockdown began and the theater suspended its shows!
say:16:1826047011:1.source_cn: 是从……从戒严以后，海歌剧院演出暂停……领主阁下就再也...

say:17:1826047012:1.text: B-But when the explosion happened on Crescent Street, someone claimed to have seen her there... gravely injured...
say:17:1826047012:1.source_cn: 不、不过，月弯街发生爆炸的时候……有人说在街上看到了她...

say:18:1826047013:1.text: I-I'm not sure if it's true! I didn't see her with my own eyes...
say:18:1826047013:1.source_cn: 但是……但是我不知道那是不是真的，我没有亲眼见到……

say:19:1826047014:1.source_cn: 嗯……这个问题你答得不错，我很满意。

say:20:1826047015:1.text: Hmm... How should I reward your effort...
say:20:1826047015:1.source_cn: 让我想想，该奖励你什么才好呢……

say:21:1826047016:1.text: Please... I want to go home!

say:22:1826047017:1.text: Go home? Oh, where's the fun in that?
say:22:1826047017:1.source_cn: 饶了你？多么无趣的提议啊。

say:23:1826047018:1.text: Ah, here's an idea. I'll give you... the chance to answer one more question!
say:23:1826047018:1.source_cn: 啊，我想到了。你的奖励是……再回答我一个问题。

say:24:1826047019:1.text: Baba Muriel, the physician from the Repair House... Where is she now?
say:24:1826047019:1.source_cn: 修缮屋的医师——那个穆婆婆，她去哪了？

say:25:1826047020:1.text: I-I haven't the faintest idea! She's vanished!

say:26:1826047021:1.text: All I know is that Bantus is after her for sabotaging a military base, and her wanted posters are plastered all over Novaris... The army even imposed a lockdown to catch her. We're too scared to leave our homes...
say:26:1826047021:1.source_cn: 班题斯说她破坏了军事基地，城里到处都是通缉令……军队为...

say:27:1826047022:1.text: M-Maybe... the Bantus army has already captured her! Y-Yes, that could explain why she's been missing for so long!
say:27:1826047022:1.source_cn: 说不定……说不定她已经被军队抓走了！对，对……她消失了...

say:28:1826047023:1.text: Captured by the Bantus army? Heh heh...
say:28:1826047023:1.source_cn: 被班题斯军队抓走了？呵呵……

say:29:1826047024:1.text: Since you're so certain, stop struggling and take your punishment!
say:29:1826047024:1.source_cn: 既然你这么信誓旦旦，那就别再挣扎了。乖乖受罚吧——！

say:36:1826049001:0.text: Vulture, didn't your liege teach you not to interrupt a man at his pleasures?
say:36:1826049001:0.source_cn: 秃鹫，你的主君难道没有告诉过你，不要打搅他人的享乐时间吗？

say:38:1826049003:1.text: Oh? Are you sure it's the one who destroyed the Refinery?
say:38:1826049003:1.source_cn: 哦？你确定你的目标就是破坏炼化间的那个魔法师？

say:42:1826049007:1.text: On my mission... I didn't see him. But he... reached the castle before you.
say:42:1826049007:1.male: On my mission... I didn't see him. But he... reached the castle before you.
say:42:1826049007:1.female: On my mission... I didn't see her. But she... reached the castle before you.

say:43:1826049008:1.text: And then... that mage never came out.

say:44:1826049009:1.text: Are you saying he was hiding somewhere in the castle while I was speaking with Tephesia?
say:44:1826049009:1.source_cn: 这么说来，我拜访苔佩希的时候，<male>他</mal...
say:44:1826049009:1.male: Are you saying he was hiding somewhere in the castle while I was speaking with Tephesia?
say:44:1826049009:1.female: Are you saying she was hiding somewhere in the castle while I was speaking with Tephesia?

say:47:1826049012:1.text: Are you sure you left that vampire half-dead?
say:47:1826049012:1.source_cn: 你确定你的刺杀没有失手，那只吸血鬼百分之百重伤垂危吗？

say:48:1826049013:1.text: She's... in bad shape. I... poisoned her to keep her bleeding.
say:48:1826049013:1.source_cn: 她……状态很差。我……用毒，让她一直流血。

say:49:1826049014:1.text: My lady said... vampires can't lose too much blood.
say:49:1826049014:1.source_cn: 主君说……吸血鬼害怕，失去太多血液。

say:50:1826049015:1.text:
Good.
You do make quite a useful pet for your lady.
say:50:1826049015:1.source_cn: 很好。\n看来你这宠物还算有用，你的主君没有白养你。

say:52:1826049017:1.text: You don't need to. Just know that Novaris is about to change hands, and I shall be its new ruler.
say:52:1826049017:1.source_cn: 你不需要明白，只需要知道：诺珐斯即将易主。而我，会是新...

say:53:1826049018:1.text: You may go now. I'll call upon you when I need you again.
say:53:1826049018:1.source_cn: 退下吧，等待我的下一条命令。

say:54:1826049019:1.text: Go? No... I only take orders from my lady.
say:54:1826049019:1.source_cn: 退下？不行……这不是，主君的命令。

say:55:1826049020:1.text: Besides... <style="highlight">Karma is outside the city, ready to attack at any moment</style>.

say:56:1826049021:1.text: Tsk! They're dead from the neck up!
say:56:1826049021:1.source_cn: 啧！真是愚蠢的怪物，他们那两颗大脑加起来恐怕还不如我的...

say:57:1826049022:1.text: You. Stay with Karma and only strike when necessary. Understood?
say:57:1826049022:1.source_cn: 你——跟着喀尔马兄弟，必要时刻再出手，懂吗？

say:13:1826067009:1.text: H-How dare you speak ill of His Majesty?! You must have a death wish!
say:13:1826067009:1.source_cn: 你……你竟敢侮辱陛下？！简直不知死活！

say:14:1826067010:1.text: Am I supposed to tremble at the mere mention of his name? Novaris fears no one!
say:14:1826067010:1.source_cn: 侮辱他又如何？难不成班题斯真的天真地以为，诺珐斯无力与...

say:15:1826067011:1.text: Oh, and do tell Thoran that he and Grezhul were right all along—I have never truly bowed to Bantus. My family and I have always loathed your vile conduct!
say:15:1826067011:1.source_cn: 回去转告托安，恭喜他和格瑞泽尔勒猜对了，余从未真心臣服...

say:16:1826067012:1.text: The gall of you. You still think the Adamant Syndicate has your back? Open your eyes! Your master has already cut you loose!
say:16:1826067012:1.source_cn: 你这狂妄的家伙！别以为黑金商会还会为你背书，你们那个老...

say:17:1826067013:1.text: Ah, thank you for reminding me. I'd almost forgotten that Pride was in cahoots with Bantus.
say:17:1826067013:1.source_cn: 多谢你的提醒，余差点忘记和班题斯狼狈为奸的还有“傲慢”...

say:18:1826067014:1.text: Go on and tell him I've achieved my goals as Sloth. He's free to bestow the title upon whomever he pleases. Though he really ought to be more careful about whom he trusts next time.
say:18:1826067014:1.source_cn: 告诉他，余已经借用“懒惰”的名号达成了目的，往后随便他...

say:19:1826067015:1.text: As for Edward... I shall have him delivered to the Lightbearer Empire. I'm certain they'll be eager to learn all about the Adamant Syndicate's... meticulous schemes through him.
say:19:1826067015:1.source_cn: 余还会将爱德华押送往耀光帝国，相信他们一定非常乐于了解...

say:20:1826067016:1.source_cn: 而现在——该你们滚出诺珐斯了。

narration:25:1826068001:1.text: Karma charges toward the city gate, followed by the Bantus army.

narration:26:1826068002:1.text: As they surge forward, a vast magic circle blazes to life beneath them, unleashing a pillar of enchanted light that tears into the sky!

narration:27:1826068003:0.text: The next instant, cries of agony fill the air. The people of Novaris shut their eyes to shield themselves from the horrifying sight.
narration:27:1826068003:0.source_cn: 惨厉的叫声此起彼伏，许多诺珐斯居民都惊恐地闭上了双眼

narration:28:1826068004:1.text: By the time the light fades, all that remain before Tephesia are Karma and Shadewing, barely clinging to life amid the drifting dust...

cinematic_dialogue:31:1826068101:.text: Unfortunately, the two of you are no match for me.
cinematic_dialogue:31:1826068101:.source_cn: 只凭你们，可不是余的对手

cinematic_dialogue:31:1826068102:.text: Guards, take them to the dungeon!
cinematic_dialogue:31:1826068102:.source_cn: 来两个守卫，把他们押到牢里

cinematic_dialogue:31:1826068103:.text: They'll make fine bargaining chips in my dealings with Bantus.

cinematic_dialogue:31:1826068105:.text: That spell really wore me out...
cinematic_dialogue:31:1826068105:.male: That spell really wore me out...
cinematic_dialogue:31:1826068105:.female: That spell really wore me out...

cinematic_dialogue:32:1826069002:.text: That mage beside her looks suspicious.
cinematic_dialogue:32:1826069002:.source_cn: 那个魔法师的身份也很可疑
cinematic_dialogue:32:1826069002:.male: That mage beside her looks suspicious.
cinematic_dialogue:32:1826069002:.female: That mage beside her looks suspicious.

cinematic_dialogue:32:1826069003:.text: I'll inform His Majesty of his involvement.
cinematic_dialogue:32:1826069003:.male: I'll inform His Majesty of his involvement.
cinematic_dialogue:32:1826069003:.female: I'll inform His Majesty of her involvement.

narration:34:180601523:0.text: Without breaking a sweat, Tephesia defeats the entire Bantus army and captures Karma and Shadewing, intending to use them as leverage in negotiations with Bantus.
narration:34:180601523:0.source_cn: 苔佩希轻而易举地挫败了进攻的班题斯军队，擒拿了喀尔马和...

narration:35:180601522:0.text: As Karma leads his army in a charge toward the city gate, Shadewing emerges from the shadows to support him. Yet Tephesia remains perfectly unruffled.
narration:35:180601522:0.source_cn: 喀尔马率领军队冲向城门，向苔佩希发动攻击，躲藏于暗处的...

narration:36:180601521:0.text: Karma uses brute force to subdue the skeletal guards blocking his path. When Tephesia arrives, she shows nothing but disdain for his approach.
narration:36:180601521:0.source_cn: 喀尔马以暴力制服了阻拦军队的骷髅守卫，然而赶来的苔佩希...

cinematic_dialogue:1:1826063002:.text: No Bantus troops may enter without permission!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1826063002:.source_cn: 未经许可，班题斯军队禁止进入！

cinematic_dialogue:1:1826063003:.text: By King Thoran's decree, Novaris is now under military control!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1826063003:.source_cn: 陛下下令，从今日起，诺珐斯由军队接管！

cinematic_dialogue:1:1826063004:.text: Nonsense! Novaris is a self-governing city!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1826063005:.text: Then you shall die for defying His Majesty's orders!
